title: A canvas is empty when nothing on it is visible
text: Every card now knows whether its canvas holds it, folded away or not. A canvas can be deleted only when nothing visible is on it. Archived cards, ended plans and parked cards no longer get in the way, and the drawer, the server and Seismic agree on that. An archived card whose canvas was deleted comes back on main, at a free spot.
